en.hubeali: And by his chain, from Ibn Mahboub, from Ali Bin Raib, from Humran,

(It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’farasws regarding a mother of a child of a Christian man, became a Muslim, can the Muslim man marry her?’ Heasws said: ‘Yes, and her waiting period from the Christian man when she became a Muslim, is a waiting period of the free divorced woman, being of three months, or three Quroos (pure periods). So when she fulfils her waiting period, so let him marry her, if he so desires to’.
